content.rendered:
Happy Friday!! Tonight is our school carnival from 4pm-8pm. Hope you can join us with your family for food, games, raffle baskets, prizes and all the fun! We look forward to seeing you there!

You can read the latest newsletter here to learn what is happening in our school.
